more.title: Rockford man hospitalized after accidental hunting accident in Mecosta Township
more.desc: MECOSTA COUNTY - A 40-year-old Rockford man was hospitalized Wednesday after accidentally shooting himself in the foot when his firearm discharged while he was hunting in Mecosta Township, according to the Mecosta County Sheriff’s Office. Deputies were called to a township residence around 6:13 p.m. for a report of a hunter who had been shot. They arrived to find the man suffering from a single gunshot wound. An initial investigation determined the shooting was accidental, and no foul play is suspected. Authorities said the man was hunting on a neighboring property when he tripped, causing his firearm to discharge and strike his foot. He administered first aid by applying a makeshift tourniquet before calling 911 for help.
